body.prompt: Cinematic film still, photorealistic documentary photography, first-person or over-the-shoulder point of view, moody dark charcoal and deep blue-black color grade with cool bluish screen glow as the main light, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, rich realistic detail, ordinary Korean apartment or office setting. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no readable screens (screens show only soft blurred glow), no watermark, no recognizable faces. Wide 16:9 composition, keep the lower fifth of the frame dark and uncluttered. Scene: Morning inside an office building elevator, first-person view looking down at one's own hand holding a smartphone at chest height, blurred office workers in dark coats around, the phone screen glowing soft blue-white (no readable content), cool fluorescent light, tense quiet mood.
